plugins.readme_text:
# 薇斯纳主题 · 无边框壁纸与底栏优化（0.3.5）

## v0.3.5 更新

- 更换为无边框壁纸，去掉穿过顶部标题的装饰横线。
- 底部状态栏加入与左侧栏一致的模糊背景。
- 统一左栏与底栏的模糊背景，减少接缝色差，保留原生直角。

## v0.3.4 更新

- 修复深色主题下部分下拉列表白底白字、选项看不清的问题。
- 感谢 devil233-ui 提供修复。

## v0.3.3 更新

- 新增聊天框效果切换，可选择液态玻璃或高斯模糊。
- 高斯模糊模式关闭动态高光与边缘折射，降低快速滚动时的渲染开销。
- 自动保存所选效果，重启后无需重新设置。

在「设置 → 薇斯纳主题 → 聊天框效果」切换。高斯模糊使用 3px 静态模糊和细边框；切换时释放液态玻璃引擎。旧设置默认保留液态玻璃。

## v0.3.2 · 2026-10-11

- 优化液态玻璃缓存，减少快速上下滚动时的卡顿。
- 停止按钮改为薇斯纳青绿色，保留原有尺寸，让按钮更醒目。

## v0.3.1 更新

- 修复应用更新后模型回答可能没有玻璃边框。
- 修复 Windows 开启全窗口壁纸时发送／停止按钮悬停闪烁（感谢 devil233-ui 的 PR #1）。

用户消息与模型回答加入透明玻璃外观：薄雾、平滑圆角、方向性边缘反光和轻微背景折射。高光快速跟随鼠标，移出自然归位；回复高度和窗口尺寸变化时自动调整。文字中央不参与边缘折射。保留原有壁纸、六款表情、配色和设置记录。

这是参考苹果设计原则的网页近似效果。支持之前核实的Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2消息结构，以及本次实际安装应用（安装包元数据0.1.7-rc.2）的消息结构。升级应用后可能需要适配。透明内容的可读性受壁纸影响；逻辑配色的对比度测试不代表任意壁纸上都达到4.5:1。

本次已在真实聊天页确认透明背景、平滑曲线和折射图正常加载；未发送模型消息。长对话滚动性能与新请求的完整流式过程仍需实际使用观察。

完整更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 制作的独立主题插件。采用用户认可的双手托脸、微瘦脸、无边框壁纸，以及六款卡通表情。浅色使用奶白遮罩，深色使用海军蓝遮罩；图片不需要联网加载。

## 使用范围

- 设置 → 通用中增加「薇斯纳主题」，提供春日浅色、夜宴深色、跟随系统和默认配色。
- 通过官方 ThemeRuntime 的 token 覆盖接口调整侧栏、阅读区域、输入区域、按钮、菜单、链接、代码块等使用平台配色变量的组件。
- 明暗偏好由 DSH 自己保存；角色配色、壁纸和表情开关单独保存在本机。恢复默认会撤下插件配色和壁纸，隐藏表情。支持读取第一版的保存记录。
- 不接触模型、凭据或聊天文件。不替换程序安装文件。
- 日常表情已接入侧栏「新会话」、主页欢迎区和「发送消息」按钮；文字、快捷键、禁用状态及原有事件处理保留。发送按钮保留小箭头，停止和删除等控件保留原生图标。设置卡片同时提供预览及壁纸/表情独立开关。
- 同一张壁纸铺满整个窗口。左栏、顶部应用控制栏和右侧工具栏采用 12px 高斯模糊及半透明遮罩；输入框、设置卡片和内容工具保持可读背景。遵循系统降低透明度偏好。

## 安装

**最简方法：** 在官方 Desktop「插件 → 添加插件」输入 `dsh-vesna-theme` 安装；可选择中国大陆镜像源或 npm 官方源。新版本在镜像源上可能存在同步延迟。该窗口是官方安装器，不代表插件通过官方市场审核。更新方式请以当前应用提示为准。


已在本机正在运行的 Desktop **0.2.0-rc.2** 中实际安装并启用。已生成 `lib/client.js`，无需自己编译。

1. 从本仓库的 **Releases** 下载 `dsh-vesna-theme-0.3.5.tgz`。
2. 打开 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop → 插件 → 添加插件**，选择下载的安装包。
3. 安装后点击「立即启用」。
4. 到 **设置 → 通用设置 → 薇斯纳主题** 选择配色、壁纸和表情开关。

本机已经完成这些操作，无需重复安装。当前使用夜宴深色，壁纸与表情开启。

本机 Desktop 版本不允许通过 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 管理，安装应走应用插件管理页面。不要用旧版全局 CLI 修改 Desktop 配置。

### 简易安装方法

把下面这段直接发给DSH：

```text
请帮我安装或更新这个DSH Desktop主题插件：https://github.com/Mahiru0427/dsh-vesna-theme
请下载最新Release的tgz安装包，保留现有主题设置，按当前Desktop版本支持的插件安装方式处理；不要使用旧版全局CLI改Desktop配置。
```

具体能否自动安装取决于DSH当前的工具权限；需要手动操作时，按上面的插件页面步骤完成。

## 恢复与卸载

临时恢复：主题设置点「默认配色」。恢复后仍保留当前原生明暗模式。

卸载：先恢复默认，再到 Plugins 禁用或移除 `dsh-vesna-theme`，退出并重新打开 Desktop。本机的角色主题选择记录保留，再次安装会沿用。插件选择与原生明暗模式是分别保存的。

## 已完成的验证

- 核对安装包 0.1.7-rc.2 的主题、设置、浏览器模块、插件包元数据与 bundle patch 接口。
- 13 项逻辑测试：持久化、关闭配色、跨窗口、损坏记录、未来版本记录保护、保存失败、清理、文字对比度、状态颜色保留、装饰开关保存、壁纸配色切换。
- 使用该版本实际的 ThemeRuntime、平台 CSS 和 React，在 Edge 无界面浏览器中验证真实插件设置组件。检查浅色、深色、系统明暗变化、重载保存、跨窗口关闭、360px 宽度、壁纸开关、表情开关、图片解码、插件卸载后的样式和标记清理；未出现浏览器脚本错误。
- 正文、辅助文字、代码与选中按钮文字的测试配色达到 4.5:1 对比度。错误、警告、成功和差异配色保留平台含义。
- 外面的预览 PNG 是组件测试页面，并非 Desktop 实际截图。实际 Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 已通过插件管理页面安装、启用，设置卡片和六表情显示正常；重新打开的窗口保留深色偏好，聊天主页壁纸正常显示。未发送模型请求；长对话和所有其他页面尚未逐页检查。

## 维护

源码在 `src`，预构建文件在 `lib`，无新增 npm 依赖。用户认可的素材位于 `assets`，以无损 WebP 保存，表情保留透明度。构建时内嵌图片，避免额外图片服务和文件路由依赖。

```text
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test tests/controller.test.mjs
```

已通过本机调试接口直接核验 Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 中的样式和操作；不使用 Computer Use。检查全窗口壁纸、左右栏、顶部模糊、侧栏收起/展开、新会话、发送按钮空输入禁用与输入后启用、独立开关、明暗切换和默认恢复；测试草稿清空，没有发送模型请求。长对话运行中的停止按钮尚未执行测试。CSS 依赖核实过的模块角色，应用升级后应重新检查。

这是非官方主题。MIT 许可仅适用于本插件代码，不包含角色名称与角色图像的权利。图片由内置 image_gen 参照用户截图生成，保留的 PNG 原图位于外部「薇斯纳主题素材」目录。

## 最新界面调整（2026-10-08）

- 只有窗口最外层铺壁纸，聊天视口及消息气泡透明，避免重复画面。
- 侧栏、顶部及右栏模糊8px；输入框取消背景模糊，使用更实的底色，修复 Windows 发送／停止按钮悬停闪烁。
- 添加文件/调用指令菜单使用不透明的主题底色，避免聊天正文透入菜单。
- 招呼语为「找我什么事呀，亲爱的朋友~」，与主页输入区靠左；欢迎表情84px。原DS图标及预览标签隐藏。
- 新会话使用36px脸部头像、48px高按钮；发送使用40px脸部与爱心头像、88×46px按钮。通过CSS裁切原画减少身体及留白，头像旁保留文字，没有箭头遮住爱心。两处悬停或键盘聚焦显示80px完整表情，移开、失焦或按键后收起。
- 添加文件保留原生加号；好的回答/有问题的回答保留原生评价图标。悬停或键盘聚焦时，分别显示64px的读书/点赞/疑惑表情。添加菜单打开时隐藏文件入口的表情。
- 六张表情均有日常位置：比耶→新会话；思考→欢迎；读书→文件入口悬停；疑惑→负面评价悬停；点赞→正面评价悬停；爱心→发送。
- 默认配色或关闭表情后恢复原生功能控件；按钮事件和可访问名称保留。

本次在实际Desktop中核验了模糊值、按钮尺寸、原生图标、文件菜单底色及悬停表情，未发送模型请求或提交回答反馈。13项逻辑测试及真实ThemeRuntime组件验证通过。长对话运行中的停止按钮未测试。

独立素材在外部「薇斯纳壁纸和独立表情」目录，包含原壁纸PNG和六张独立透明通道PNG；只裁分原图，没有重新绘制。


## 头像按钮方案验收

在实际应用检查新会话、发送的脸部裁切、完整悬停预览和键盘聚焦；原画文件未修改。页面切换后仍能显示预览，空输入发送保持禁用，无横向溢出。浮层避开按钮、保持在窗口范围内，关闭主题或卸载会移除浮层和事件监听。ThemeRuntime组件验证通过，未发送模型请求或回答反馈。


## 主页输入区自适应修正

主页输入区宽度约为可用内容区的38%，窄屏最小360px并受容器边距限制，使其右缘约停在壁纸人物左侧耳朵位置；编辑区域最小高度随输入区宽度变化，范围52–160px。保持普通窗口和宽屏的视觉比例。

通过已连接实际DSH页面的临时视口尺寸测试：1280、2400、900、700px宽度。更新后普通窗口输入卡片约346×127px，宽屏约771×156px；右缘停在壁纸人物左侧耳朵附近。无横向溢出、发送按钮未越界，聊天页原有输入框样式保持。测试后已撤销视口模拟并恢复原窗口显示。没有发送消息。

## v0.3.1 修复验证

新增构建类名的模型回答、延迟加载消息样式和清理逻辑已做浏览器回归；实际 Desktop 中确认模型回答玻璃边框和输入框无 backdrop-filter，并检查有文字时发送按钮悬停，测试草稿已清空。13 项逻辑测试通过。运行中的停止按钮修复由 PR #1 作者在 Windows 11 实测确认，本机仅验证停止状态样式，没有发起模型请求。


v0.3.2 浏览器对照回归：六条消息往返滚动，预热后重复贴图编码由 48 次降至 0 次。该结果验证减少重复计算，不代表所有设备的帧率保证。停止按钮为 34px 青绿色圆形底座，16px SVG。


v0.3.3 验证：14项逻辑测试通过；真实 React 与 ThemeRuntime 组件验证切换、重载保存、明暗主题及360px窄屏。浏览器回归确认高斯模式无SVG折射滤镜，滚动与鼠标移动不产生贴图编码，切回液态模式只保留一个引擎。尚未取得贡献者电脑的帧率对照结果。


## 社区市场发现与分发

本仓库已添加 `dsh-plugin` GitHub Topic，支持按该 Topic 搜索的社区市场发现。各市场的索引刷新和兼容性筛选不同，添加标签不代表官方认证或已被所有市场收录。

正式安装包在 GitHub Releases；npm 已公开发布，可按包名 `dsh-vesna-theme` 安装。最新 npm 版本请以 registry 查询结果为准。

维护者发布 npm：登录自己的 npm 账号后，在仓库目录执行 `npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org`。发布前会重新构建并运行逻辑测试。


v0.3.5 验证：无框 PNG 到 WebP 为逐像素一致的无损转换；底栏随输入框增高更新边界，卸载清理还原样式。14 项逻辑测试和真实 React/ThemeRuntime 浏览器回归通过。交界保留原生直角，macOS 实机体验仍待用户确认。

plugins.description: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a captain plus members with their own prompt, model, reasoning effort, and tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-team-presets *Concept illustration. See [Screenshots](#screenshots) for the plugin interface; the captain uses the conversation's selected model.* English | [中文]() > **Community plugin v0.1.6** · [Release](https://github.com/bloodarea/dsh-agent-team-presets/releases/tag/v0.1.6) > > Requires a compatible DeepSeek Harness deployment with Agent Teams enabled. This version supports DSH rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2 APIs; see [Requirements](#requirements). Prebuilt artifacts are included, so installation does not require a source build. ## Overview **dsh-agent-team-presets** is a visual Team preset and private skill manager for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Configure a Team once, assign per-agent isolated skills, then select it from the conversation composer whenever you need it. A Team contains a **captain** and any number of **member roles**: - The captain uses the conversation's selected model, with its own role description, system prompt, and tool policy. - Each member can have an independent provider, model, reasoning effort, system prompt, tool policy, and assigned Team Skills. - The captain summons members through `spawn_team_member`; native Agent Teams provides messaging, the shared task board, and runtime coordination. This is a community plugin, not the Harness's bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-presets` development package. ## Why this plugin? DeepSeek Harness already ships Agent Teams with multi-agent collaboration. In the Harness versions this plugin supports, per-Team configuration, skill isolation, and reuse are still left to the user, which is what this plugin addresses: - **Teams are hard to reuse.** In those versions, native teams focus on runtime creation and collaboration, with no visual preset management; this plugin saves, duplicates, categorizes, and reuses named presets. - **Role setup is repetitive.** Each role's name, description, system prompt, and tool policies are configured once instead of re-described every time. - **Splitting work across models is awkward.** Every member picks its own model and reasoning effort, so one Team combines models by task, while the captain keeps leading on the Session's model. - **Tool permissions have no fine-grained entry point.** In those versions the native tool surface offers no per-role allow-list; here the captain and each member carry their own, so roles differ in what they may use. - **Skills lack per-agent scope isolation.** Shipped or user skills are typically registered globally, making all skills visible to every agent; this plugin provides a private Team Skill library where skills are discovered **only** by the specific Agent they are assigned to. - **Switching teams is inconvenient.** Pick a preset Team directly from the composer instead of rebuilding roles by hand. **Design principle:** native Agent Teams owns collaboration at runtime; this plugin owns configuring, managing, isolating, and reusing teams and their skills. ## Features - **Reusable Teams:** create, duplicate, edit, select, and delete named presets. - **Per-member model routes:** assign models and reasoning effort to individual roles without changing the captain's model. - **Independent tool policies:** choose all available tools or a custom allow-list for the captain and each member. - **Nine built-in presets across two series:** three software development scale teams (Lightweight, Standard, Full-Stack) and six specialized work-mode teams (Discovery, Planning, Workflow, Engineering, Security Audit, Research). - **Display metadata:** attach summary, tags, use cases, quick prompts (suggested tasks), and notes per Team. Strictly presentation-only: never injected into the runtime LLM context, saving context tokens. - **Local categories and search:** organize presets into custom categories via a dedicated category manager; instantly search over name, summary, tags, and use cases in both Settings and the Composer picker. - **Private Team Skill library:** import skill folders or ZIP archives into a plugin-owned store (`~/.dsh/team-skills`), completely isolated from global host skills. - **Per-agent skill isolation:** a 3-column assignment grid on member pages assigns skills to specific roles. Assigned skills are registered **strictly in that Agent's scope** when summoned—never leaked globally. - **Official built-in skills & local overrides:** ships `github-repository-presentation` and `git-release-hygiene` materialized into the private library and pre-bound to engineering roles. Create local editable overrides and one-click restore them to the built-in copy (`恢复为插件内置版本`). - **Guarded deletion with blocker modal:** deleting a skill bound to any role, in use by an active member, or required as a dependency is refused, with a confirmation modal detailing every blocking holder. - **Dependency verification:** checks declared CLI executables against host `PATH` (flags found/missing and refuses assignment when absent) and reports declared MCP servers. - **Agent-facing tools:** root sessions provide `list_team_skills`, `assign_team_skill`, `unassign_team_skill`, and `remove_team_skill` alongside `get_team_preset` and `update_team_preset`. - **Live settings feedback:** see whether a Team is idle, busy, or awaiting an update in an online Session. - **Theme integration:** robust light and dark mode adaptation across all cards, dialogs, inputs, and dropdowns. ## Contents - [Overview](#project-introduction) - [Why this plugin?](#why-this-plugin) - [Features](#features) - [Screenshots](#screenshots) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Install and upgrade](#use-this-package) - [Configure and use a Team](#configure-a-team) - [Display metadata, categories, and search](#metadata-categories-search) - [Private Team Skills and per-agent isolation](#team-skills) - [Share presets](#share-presets) - [Agent-facing tools](#agent-facing-tools) - [Tool permissions and security](#tool-permissions) - [Troubleshooting and limitations](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [How it works](#understand-the-implementation) - [Development and contributing](#development) - [Related resources](#further-exploration) - [License](#license) ## Screenshots The screenshots illustrate the v0.1.6 settings interface, Team Skill management, and composer workflow. Example provider and model names depend on your deployment. **Manage Teams: tabs, search, source and series filters** ![Team list in Settings]() **Choose a Team in the composer with search and source filters** ![Composer Team picker]() **Private Team Skill library with origin badges and actions** ![Team Skill library]() **Assign Team Skills to a member role** ![Member Team Skill assignment grid]() **Skill details: file tree, editor, and local copy actions** ![Team Skill detail view]() **Guarded skill deletion with blocking holders modal** ![Skill delete blocker dialog]() **Manage custom preset categories** ![Team preset categories page]() **Team editor: display metadata, category picker, and status notices** ![Team editor]()
More screenshots (model routing, custom dropdowns, prompts, and tool policies) **Category dropdown in Team editor** ![Category select popup]() **Filter Teams by custom source** ![Custom source filter]() **Configure member models and reasoning effort** ![Member model settings]() **Model picker** ![Model picker]() **Captain and member system prompts** ![Captain system prompt]() ![Member system prompt](

plugins.description: DSH Web 界面底部常驻标注：充值余额 + 本次会话消费（按账户余额差测量，非本地 token 估算）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-meter

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DSH Web GUI 底部（输入框下方、官方统计胶囊那一行）常驻一行标注，实时显示：

- **充值余额** —— 取自官方账号服务（`deepseekAccount.getBalance`），就是充值余额本身；
  和官方账户卡片一样，**赠金余额不并进来**（赠金是发放/到期的，不是花掉的），
  它只在展开的明细里单独一行显示；
- **本次消费** —— 当前会话到目前为止花掉的钱，由**账户余额差**测量得出，不是本地按 token 估算。

点一下可以展开明细（充值余额、赠金余额、余额采样时间、本次消费、观测窗口、期间充值、
系数校验），点一下同时立即刷新一次余额。

```
余额 ¥4.56 · 本次 ¥0.2130
```

![输入框下方那一行：官方统计胶囊右侧是本插件的「余额 本次」标注](docs/pill.png)

展开后是明细面板（与官方统计胶囊点开的浮层同一套样式；截图已裁去右列数值）：

![明细面板：充值余额、余额采样于、数据年龄、本次消费、基准时点、观测窗口、累计结算、系数校验、Token 合计](docs/panel.png)

## 为什么用「余额差」而不是按 token 估算

DeepSeek 只对外提供一个关于钱的准确数字：账户余额。它没有"按会话查消费"的接口。
所以某一次会话的准确花费只能这样还原：

```
本次消费 = Σ max(0, 上一次观测余额 − 这一次观测余额)
```

在会话存活期间记录的观测序列上求和；余额**上升**的那次不算消费（那是充值或赠送），
只记为「期间充值」并把基准一起抬上去。因为计费是随请求结算发生的，这个差值会收敛到
官方账单，而不需要我们在本地重新给任何一个 token 定价。

明细里的「系数校验（估算）」是另一条独立线索：把该会话在宿主侧累计的 token 用量按配置
单价折算成金额，用来交叉验证余额差是否合理。**它永远不会成为主数字**。

## 安装

```sh
# 本地目录（开发调试：改完跑 pnpm run build 再刷新页面，link 安装无需重装）
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/绝对路径/dsh-balance-meter

# npm 作用域包（尚未发布，见下方「发布」）
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @amo-aibiancheng/dsh-balance-meter@latest
```

> **包名说明**：本插件发布在作者作用域下（`@amo-aibiancheng/`）。npm 上另有一个无作用域的
> `dsh-balance-meter`，是**别人写的、功能相近**的插件（同为 dsh Web GUI 的余额/用量读数），
> 两者不是同一个项目，安装时别弄混。
>
> 仓库名仍是 `dsh-balance-meter`（npm 包名不必等于仓库名）；`cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的
> `id` 也用这个短名——它只是个 cell key，与包名无关，而 `name` 才是可解析的包名。

`<profile>` 换成你实际使用的 profile 名（例如 `desktop`、`web`）。
装好后**重启一次 dsh**（宿主半需要重新加载），刷新页面即可看到标注。

不想用命令时，等价的手工做法：在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖，再在 profile 的
`cordis.patch.yml` 里加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-balance-meter
      name: '@amo-aibiancheng/dsh-balance-meter'
```

### 从源码构建

本包把构建产物（`lib/`）一并提交，所以 `link:` 安装不需要构建步骤；只有改代码时才需要：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Amo-aibiancheng/dsh-balance-meter.git
cd dsh-balance-meter
pnpm install
pnpm run build          # tsc 出 lib/types，tsdown 出 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:$PWD
```

改客户端半时开着 `pnpm run watch`，改完刷新页面即可；改宿主半需要重启 dsh。

## 配置

全部有默认值，改配置就是改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `config:`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-balance-meter
  name: '@amo-aibiancheng/dsh-balance-meter'
  config:
    pollIntervalMs: 45000      # 余额采样间隔（5000 – 1800000），下限是给官方接口留的余量
    requestTimeoutMs: 20000    # 单次余额查询超时（3000 – 120000）
    anomalyRatio: 0.5          # 单次跌幅超过余额的这个比例 → 视为账号事件，不计入会话
    showTokenCrossCheck: true  # 明细里是否给出 token 折算的交叉校验
    price:                     # 仅供交叉校验使用（元/百万 token）
      currency: CNY
      cacheHit: 0.1
      cacheMiss: 3
      output: 9
```

`Config` 是按官方插件同款写的 **schemastery schema**（不是手写默认值对象）：加载器会调用
schema 本身来解析这一行，纯对象会让插件行**直接加载失败**——这正是第一版崩在
`failed to import` 的原因，现在由 `test/host.test.mjs` 的激活用例守着。

越界值会被 schema 直接拒绝，不会流到官方接口。所有可调字段都是 `volatile()`：在设置里改动
会**立刻**作用于正在运行的这一行（宿主每读一次配置都经过 `.get()`），无需重启。

## 算法与边界

| 情形 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话创建时插件已在观测 | 以会话出生时刻的余额为基准，差值即本次消费（`基准 = session-start`） |
| 会话早于本进程（插件是后来才启动的） | 以已知最早的一次观测为基准，并在明细里标注「本次金额是下限」（`partial`） |
| 余额上升（充值 / 赠送 / 退款） | 不计为消费，记入「期间充值」，基准一起抬高，后续消费仍然准确 |
| 同一余额被重复读到（重试 / 双开轮询） | 视为同一次观测，直接丢弃：这是"绝不重复计费"的根据 |
| 单次跌幅超过余额 50% | 视为账号级事件（赠送到期、钱包切换），重新取基准而不是记成消费 |
| 观测乱序到达 | 插入到时间线中正确的位置；"当前余额"始终取时间最新的那次观测，不会被旧值覆盖 |
| 币种消失/切换 | 不做跨缺口差分，直接重新取基准 |
| 余额读取失败 | 记为不可读，绝不当成 0，因此不会凭空造出一笔消费 |
| 账户有赠金 | 主数字只显示充值余额（与官方账户卡片一致），赠金单独一行；两者永不相加 |
| 两次消费间隔很短 | 只要金额不同就分别计入（曾经用过"最小间隔"保护，结果会**漏掉真实消费**，已删除该规则） |

**已知边界（如实写在明细里，不藏）**：钱包属于**账号**，不属于会话。同一个账号在另一个
窗口或另一台机器上的消费会落进同一个差值里。单客户端、单账号时这个差值就是准确的；同时
多开时「本次消费」会偏大。同理，插件的采样是轮询的，两次采样之间的账会被合并进下一次。

## 实现结构

```
src/core/ledger.ts      纯函数算法核心（无 Node、无 DOM）：观测时间线 + 每会话累加器
src/index.ts            宿主半：schemastery Config、读官方余额、轮询、token 记账、/dsh-balance-meter/* 路由
src/client/index.tsx    浏览器半入口：注册 conversation.composer.dock 条目
src/client/BalanceChip.tsx  底部胶囊与明细面板（React，props 取自槽位声明）
src/client/format.ts    金额/时长格式化（子单位保留 4 位小数等规则）
src/client/wire.ts      两端之间的数据结构与 fetch（浏览器半只依赖它）
lib/index.js            构建产物：宿主半（ESM）
lib/client.js           构建产物：浏览器半（__ModuleLoader__ 闭包）
lib/types/**            构建产物：类型声明
test/ledger.test.mjs    算法用例：逐条钉住上表的每一行
test/host.test.mjs      宿主用例：真实 cordis 上的激活/卸载、路由、降级路径、Config 校验
test/client.test.mjs    浏览器半用例：模块格式、槽位注册、渲染
test/format.test.mjs    金额格式化用例
```

### 按 DSH 官方插件的约定写

- **TypeScript + 官方构建链**：`tsc` 出类型声明到 `lib/types`，`tsdown` 出 `lib/index.js`
  与 `lib/client.js`，与 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包自身的发布形态一致（`main` / `types` / `exports`）。
- **类型来自 SDK，不是猜的**：`PropsRuntime<'conversation.composer.dock'>` 直接取槽位声明的
  真实 props（`sessionId`、`useProjection` 由 `dsh-client-ui-session` 的模块增强提供），
  宿主侧用 `ctx.deepseekAccount` / `ctx.webServer` 的官方类型。`pnpm run typecheck` 就是这道闸门。
- **Config 是 schemastery schema**，可被设置页生成、可被加载器解析。
- **浏览器半不打包 React**：`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/*` 一律留作
  `require()`，由壳的原生模块表解析；打进来第二份 React 会直接破坏 hooks 边界。
- **凭据不出宿主**：浏览器半只读本插件自己的路由，从不接触 token。
- **一份状态**：计费累加器只存在于宿主，多标签页不会各记各的账。
- **不抢宿主 UI**：只往 `conversation.composer.dock` 追加一个 list 条目（`order: 20`，
  官方统计胶囊仍是 `order: 0`），不覆盖任何既有座位。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check      # typecheck → build → test（49 条用例）
pnpm run build      # 只构建
pnpm run typecheck  # 只类型检查（对着真实 SDK 类型）
pnpm run watch      # 改客户端半时增量构建
```

`link:` 安装下改完代码跑一次 `pnpm run build`、刷新页面即可，不需要重装。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Startup & turn-completion chimes for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, with an in-app control panel and switchable sound library (Windows, zero dependencies).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chimes

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Two chimes for the **DeepSeek Harness desktop app**: one when the app **opens**, one when a **turn finishes**.

![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-blue)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)
![assets](https://img.shields.io/badge/assets-CC0-lightgrey)
![deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen)

> The repository **ships nine example chimes** — six CC0 tones synthesized with ffmpeg plus three
> the author picked and confirmed free of third-party copyright claims (**those two are the
> out-of-the-box defaults**) — and it supports **your own audio**, switchable from a dropdown in the
> control panel. It deliberately contains no sound material of unknown provenance; see
> [docs/音效与版权.md](docs/音效与版权.md) (Chinese) for the reasoning.

---

## What it does

| Chime | Fires when | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Startup** | The desktop app opens, just as the window is about to render | Once per launch; plugin reloads and page refreshes stay silent |
| **Done** | A conversation turn completes successfully | **User sessions only** — delegated/subagent sessions are skipped; errors and aborts are silent |

Both play **host-side** through the Windows `System.Media.SoundPlayer`, so:

- the window does **not** need to be focused — walk away and you'll still hear it;
- browser autoplay policies do not apply (which is why this is not a Web Audio plugin).

## Requirements

- **Windows** (uses .NET `Media.SoundPlayer`)
- **DSH desktop app** (`desktop` profile), launched at least once
- PowerShell 5.1+
- `ffmpeg` — only if your audio needs converting (non-PCM-WAV input)

## Install

```powershell
# recommended, one command (replace boring-cuzzz with your GitHub username)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:boring-cuzzz/dsh-chimes

# or from a local clone
git clone https://github.com/boring-cuzzz/dsh-chimes.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add .\dsh-chimes
```

Then **fully quit and reopen DSH** — the startup chime should play. Send any message and wait for
the reply to end — the done chime should play.

## Control panel & sound library

After installing, open the **Plugins page in the sidebar → Chimes** (on some cores:
**Settings → Plugins**). No command line needed:

| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Startup / Completion switches** | Enable each chime independently — takes effect **immediately**, no restart |
| **Sound library dropdown** | Switch between the nine bundled examples and **your own sounds** |
| **Preview** | Plays through the **real playback path**, not a browser simulation |
| **Choose audio…** | Any mp3 / m4a / wav / ogg / flac — **converted to WAV in the browser**, so ffmpeg is not required |
| **Delete** | Removes entries from "my sounds" only; bundled examples are protected |
| **Rename** | Name your own sounds — **the file name is the label the dropdown shows**; bundled examples cannot be renamed |
| **Undo / Restore default** | Go back to the previous pick, or to the bundled example |

**Sounds you add stay in the dropdown**, so switching later is one click.

They live in `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\chimes-library\` — **outside the repository**, so they can never be
committed by accident.

**Want them on another drive** (say the system drive is nearly full)? Add one line to
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\chimes-state.json` — no code change needed:

```json
{ "version": 1, "libraryDir": "D:\\MySounds" }
```

Precedence: the `DSH_CHIMES_LIBRARY` environment variable → that `libraryDir` key → the default path.
Copy your audio over and hit **Refresh** in the panel. If a stored selection ever points at a file
that no longer exists, the plugin falls back to another playable sound instead of going silent.

## Bring your own sound (command line, optional)

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-chime.ps1 `
    -Startup "D:\sounds\open.mp3" `
    -Done    "D:\sounds\done.mp3"
```

Only one chime to change? Pass only that argument. `-Volume 0.8` bakes in a gain.

**Two hard requirements** (the panel handles both automatically):

- the audio must be **PCM WAV** (`pcm_s16le`) — renaming an mp3 to `.wav` will **not** play;
- volume must be baked in at conversion time (`ffmpeg -af "volume=1.5"`), because `SoundPlayer`
  has no volume API.

More detail: [docs/音效与版权.md](docs/音效与版权.md)

## Configuration

Both chimes are independent loader rows. Edit `cordis.patch.yml` in your profile:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: startup-chime
      name: dsh-chimes
      config:
        kind: startup
        enabled: true
        delayMs: 350        # extra wait after the UI is ready before playing
        waitMs: 6000        # give up waiting and play anyway
    - id: done-chime
      name: dsh-chimes
      config:
        kind: done
        enabled: true
        cooldownMs: 1500    # minimum gap between two chimes
        minTurnMs: 0        # set e.g. 5000 to chime only for longer turns
```

**Mute everything:** set `DSH_CHIME_MUTE=1`.

## Troubleshooting

Read the log first — every trigger appends a line to
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\startup-chime.log` or `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\done-chime.log`.

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| No sound, and the log has no `module imported` | plugin never loaded | enable it on the Plugins page; check `dsh.profile.bundles` |
| `PLAYING` logged, but `player exited` after ~90 ms | audio is not a valid PCM WAV | re-encode it |
| `SKIP wav not found` | wrong `wavPath` | use an absolute path that exists |
| `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively…` | you used a standalone `dsh` from npm | use the launcher bundled with the desktop app |

## Security

Zero network calls, zero telemetry, zero credential access. No runtime dependencies and no
`postinstall`. The player process receives only 4 environment variables, so the harness's API keys
never reach it; PowerShell is invoked by absolute path (no `PATH` lookup) and the audio path is
passed via an environment variable (no command-injection surface). Details — including the general
privilege boundary of DSH plugins — are in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Compatibility

Tested with DSH desktop **0.2.0-rc.2** on Windows 11. The plugin intentionally declares **no
`peerDependencies`**, so it never trips DSH's install-time peer gate. It activates only in the
`desktop` profile. Subagent exclusion relies on session header fields the runtime itself validates
(`origin === 'subagent'`, `delegationDepth`, `parentSession`) rather than guessing id prefixes.

## License

- **Code:** [MIT](LICENSE)
- **Placeholder audio in `assets/`:** [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
  (synthesized from sine waves with ffmpeg, reproducible)

## Contributing

PRs welcome. Three rules:

1. **Do not submit third-party audio** (game rips, movie/music clips, stock libraries) — it creates
   DMCA exposure for the whole repository.
2. Self-made sounds are fine: state in the PR that you created it and license it as CC0.
3. Keep `scripts/*.ps1` as **UTF-8 with BOM** (Windows PowerShell 5.1 misreads BOM-less UTF-8
   containing non-ASCII text and fails to parse the script — see [.gitattributes](.gitattributes)).

## Related

- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — the everything-is-a-plugin agent harness
- GitHub topic [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) — community plugin ecosystem

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：切面（facet）—— /visualize 一个名字或 arXiv 链接，主 agent 调研 + 双子代理并行生成 2D/3D 架构图谱，浮窗直接弹出 | A name or paper in, structured diagram windows out
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-facet

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：**切面 —— 任意内容进，结构化图谱出。**
> 在对话里输入 `/visualize <模型名 | arXiv 链接 | 一句话需求>`，主 agent 自动调研、
> 定「生成计划」（模式 + 视图清单），为每个视图派一个独立子代理并行画出图谱，
> 窗口直接在界面上弹出。

## 特点

- **一句话 → 一组图谱**：模型架构 / RL·Agent 训练管线 / 攻防·红蓝关系 / 论文工作流……
  自动识别内容类型并选模板；都不像时先用通用兜底（generic），必要时还能按规范**现场"造"一个新模式**（存起来，下次同类内容自动复用——框架自己长大）。
- **视图词表（文件名即约定）**：`diagram`（2D 结构图）/ `tower`（3D 层塔）/ `network`（3D 关系网络）/ `flow`（流程管线）/ `timeline`（时间线）。
  渲染层封闭（视图只有这几种 + 固定色板，风格永不崩），语义层开放（模式可生长）。
- **浮窗自动弹出**：产物就绪经 SSE 通知界面——桌面 1 视图=单窗、2 视图=双窗并排、≥3 视图=标签栏；手机单窗多标签。窗口可拖动/最大化/刷新/关闭。
- **风格铁律（视觉一致性）**：固定 10 色色板（hex 单源）；低置信字段＝虚线 + `?`；非标准/自研要素＝加粗描边 + `★`；页脚含来源——同一个插件画出来的图长得像一家人。
- **可分享的产物**：所有视图都是**单文件 HTML**（2D 类内联 SVG 零依赖；3D 类引 jsdelivr CDN 的 three.js，手机浏览器直接能转能缩）。
- **复核友好**：回复里只有一行人类摘要（不贴 JSON）；全量 `spec.json` 静默落盘，随查随看。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://codeload.github.com/wobenshiwomu/dsh-facet/tar.gz/v0.2.0'
```

或在图形界面：侧栏「插件」→ 添加插件 → 填上面这条 URL。装完重启 DSH 生效。
URL 末段的 `v0.2.0` 是版本标签；升级时换成本仓库的新版本标签重装即可。

## 使用

在任意对话里输入（名字、论文链接、或者一句大白话都行）：

```
/visualize Qwen3-0.6B
/visualize https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.21783
/visualize 把 GRPO 的训练流程画出来
```

接下来自动发生：

1. 主 agent 理解内容类型并调研（arXiv 链接优先精读论文；否则走搜索）
2. 你收到一行摘要：`将生成 N 张图（kind1 + kind2）· 来源：…`
3. 每个视图派一个独立子代理，**并行**生成 `<kind>.html`
4. **浮窗自动弹出**；最终回复里同时给出各视图直链

直链形如（关掉浮窗后依然可用）：

```
http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-facet/<slug>/diagram.html
http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-facet/<slug>/tower.html
```

产物索引页：`http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-facet/`

## 模式与视图

内置模式（主 agent 自动识别选用）：

| 模式 | 视图清单 | 语义配色（节选） |
|---|---|---|
| `model-architecture` 模型架构 | diagram + tower | 注意力橙 / FFN 蓝 / 嵌入紫 / 归一化绿 / 循环·状态藤紫 |
| `rl-training` RL·Agent 训练管线 | flow + timeline | 采样紫 / 奖励橙 / 更新蓝 / 缓冲绿 / 环境藤紫 |
| `red-team` 攻防·红蓝关系 | network + timeline | 攻击橙 / 防守蓝 / 资产紫 / 工具绿 / 边界虚线灰 |
| `workflow` 论文工作流 | flow（单视图示例） | 步骤蓝 / 决策橙 / 输入输出紫 / 循环藤紫 |
| `generic` 通用兜底 | diagram + flow | 自行按语义归类（同类同色），页脚注明映射 |

视图词表（文件名 = `<kind>.html`）：

| kind | 是什么 | 技术 |
|---|---|---|
| `diagram` | 2D 结构/关系图（自上而下分层、重复组 ×N） | 内联 SVG |
| `tower` | 3D 分层堆叠视图 | three.js |
| `network` | 3D 关系网络（力导向） | three.js |
| `flow` | 流程/管线图（含循环回边） | 内联 SVG |
| `timeline` | 时间线（可带泳道） | 内联 SVG |

## 自造模式（OOD 一点点魔法）

内容不属于任何内置模式时：先用 `generic` 兜底；若主 agent 确信值得一个新模式，
它会写一个 ≤50 行的 JSON 到 `$DSH_HOME/facet/modes/<name>.json`：

```json
{ "name": "crypto-protocol", "label": "密码协议",
  "views": ["flow", "timeline"],
  "colors": { "密钥交换": "#1C7ED6", "验证": "#E8590C" } }
```

限制：`views` 只能取自词表、颜色只能用色板、名字小写 kebab——**渲染层封闭、语义层开放**。
保存后本次即按它执行，以后同类内容自动复用（索引页会标出自定义模式）。

## 产物结构

```
$DSH_HOME/facet/<slug>/
├── spec.json      # 通用图结构：nodes / edges / groups + 来源与置信度
├── diagram.html   # 视图文件（文件名 = <kind>.html）
├── tower.html     # …每个视图一个单文件 HTML
└── meta.json      # 生成元数据（query / mode / views / 状态）

$DSH_HOME/facet/modes/<name>.json   # 自造模式（OOD 时生成，可复用）
```

## 配置（可选配置 · 不配置即默认）

**默认开箱即用**，无需任何配置。仅当要改默认值时才需要：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml（示例）
- id: dsh-facet
  config:
    homeDir: ''      # 产物根目录，默认 $DSH_HOME/facet
    readyPing: true  # 产物就绪后推送浮窗事件（默认开）
```

## 工作机制（给好奇的人）

- 命令处理器只做确定性的事：校验参数 → 生成 slug → 建目录写 `meta.json(pending)` → 读取自定义模式 → 把**工作流提示词**（含模式表、视图词表、spec 规范、风格铁律、自造模式规范）以 user 消息注入当前 agent（与官方 `/goal` 同款 `agent.followup` 通路）。
- 智能的事交给 agent：识别内容 → 调研 → 写成通用图结构的 `spec.json` → 用内置 `subagent` 工具**为每个视图并行派发独立子代理**。
- 收尾走 `facet_ready` 工具：校验视图文件 → 写 `meta.views` → SSE 广播（载荷含 `views:[{kind,title,url}]`）→ 界面浮窗弹出；各视图直链同时回给 agent 放进最终回复。
- HTTP 路由（`/dsh-facet/*`）挂在 webServer 上（可选依赖——无 web 服务的几何下插件照常工作，仅少了浮窗与直链）。

## 已知边界

- 浮窗由**实时事件**触发：页面刷新后浮窗不还原（用消息里的直链即可再开）。
- 一次 `/visualize` 的成本 = 1 轮调研 + N 个子代理（N=该模式视图数，1~3），按需触发。
- 3D 视图的 three.js 走 jsdelivr CDN（首次打开需联网）。

## 开发

```sh
npm test       # 仿真测试：122 项断言（命令/提示词/ready/回退链/SSE/路由/词表）
npm run build  # esbuild 编译客户端半区（Termux 用 @esbuild/android-arm64 二进制）
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Themes and personalisation for DeepSeek Harness: 17 themes, a theme editor, liquid-glass panels, wallpapers, custom logo/greeting, saved prompts and a Ctrl+K quick switcher
plugins.readme_text:
# Studio for DeepSeek Harness

Themes and personalisation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): 18 themes, a theme editor that builds themes from a mood, one colour, any word or any picture, a theme per workspace, a community gallery of themes and prompt packs, liquid-glass panels, wallpapers (Bing daily, slideshows and video), fonts, saved looks on a schedule that can follow sunrise and sunset, your Windows accent colour, layout controls and a focus mode, AI modes, task-finished alerts, a usage and cost dashboard with spending alerts, chat export to Markdown and PDF, accessibility options, smarter saved prompts, settings sync, a Ctrl+K quick switcher, and 19 languages.

Zero npm dependencies. Your settings stay on your machine unless you turn on sync.

![Studio with the Liquid Glass theme and frosted-glass panels](docs/screenshots/themes-dark.jpg)

| Liquid glass + personal greeting | Quick switcher (live preview) | Theme editor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Frosted-glass composer over a wallpaper, greeting "Good night, RdotA"](docs/screenshots/greeting.jpg) | ![Ctrl+K quick switcher previewing Tokyo Night](docs/screenshots/quick-switcher.jpg) | ![Theme editor: moods, one colour, any word, with the Cyber mood previewed across the app](docs/screenshots/theme-editor.jpg) |

| Community gallery | Usage & cost (sample data) | Looks & schedule, in Japanese |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Gallery tab with community themes and their authors](docs/screenshots/gallery.jpg) | ![Usage tab: totals, 30-day chart and per-model prices](docs/screenshots/usage.jpg) | ![Saved looks and a time-of-day schedule, interface in Japanese](docs/screenshots/looks-schedule-ja.jpg) |

| Prompts that ask first | Saved prompts | Light mode (Synthwave) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![A saved prompt asking for Topic and Audience before inserting](docs/screenshots/prompt-questions.jpg) | ![Saved prompts menu beside the composer](docs/screenshots/saved-prompts.jpg) | ![Studio themes page in light mode](docs/screenshots/themes-light.jpg) |

## Install

**From the app:** open DSH → sidebar **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → enter

```
github:IRdotAI/dsh-studio
```

**From a terminal:**

```
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:IRdotAI/dsh-studio
```

Then restart `dsh web`. A **Studio** entry appears in the sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2 (tested with 0.2.0-rc.2), the web profile, and Node 22.5+. `pnpm` must be on your PATH for plugin installs (`npm install -g pnpm`).

Already on 1.3 or later? Studio offers the update itself (**Studio → Updates**).

To remove it, use **Uninstall** on its Plugins page entry.

## Using it

- **Studio** in the sidebar has everything, in tabs. Pick your language in the top-right corner (**Automatic** follows your browser, or DSH itself when it's set to Chinese).
- **Ctrl+K** (Cmd+K on macOS) opens the quick switcher anywhere: themes (arrow through them to preview live; Esc puts yours back), your looks, AI modes, light/dark, text size, chat width, focus mode, ambience, saved prompts, alerts, chat export, backup, updates and every Studio page.
- In the composer, type **/theme**, **/ai**, **/transcript**, **/prompts**, **/focus** or **/studio**, or click the **✦** button beside the input for saved prompts.

## Features

| Area | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| **18 themes** | Liquid Glass, Midnight, Dracula, Nord, Tokyo Night, Catppuccin, Rosé Pine, Gruvbox, Solarized, Forest, Ocean, Synthwave, Sakura, Arc Reactor, Espresso, Paper, AMOLED and High Contrast, plus the stock look. Each has a light and a dark version, so DSH's Light / Dark / System switch keeps working. |
| **Theme per workspace** | Give any workspace its own theme or look, so you can tell your projects apart at a glance. It switches as you move between workspaces and goes back to your usual theme everywhere else. |
| **Theme editor** | Pick a background, text and accent colour per mode, plus an optional second accent for gradients. Studio derives every surface, border, button and text shade from them in OKLCH, with contrast floors so secondary text stays readable. Live contrast badges with one-click **Fix**, a screen colour picker 💧, any CSS colour (`rgb(…)`, `hsl(…)`, `tomato`), **undo/redo** (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), **Make Light from Dark** (and back), a colour-blindness preview, whole-app preview while editing, shareable `dshs1:` codes and `.json` theme files. |
| **Make a theme** | Twelve **moods** (Calm, Cozy, Cyber, Sunset…, a new take every click), **one colour** with a colour-harmony rule (monochrome, analogous, complementary, split, triadic), **any word** (the same word always makes the same theme), or 🎲 Surprise me. **Lock** 🔒 the colours you like and generators keep them. **Fine-tune** sliders move the whole theme (hue, vividness, warmth, background), and **Variations** offers eight ready-made twists. Text always stays readable. |
| **Theme from an image** | Build a theme from your desktop wallpaper, your Studio wallpaper or any picture: Studio clusters its colours, picks a background tint and accents, and fits them for contrast in both modes. |
| **Community gallery** | **Studio → Gallery** lists themes and prompt packs shared by other users; one click adds a theme or a whole pack of prompts. **Submit to the gallery** in the theme editor, or on a prompt folder, opens GitHub with your file ready to propose. See [gallery/](gallery/). |
| **Looks & schedule** | Save your theme, style and wallpaper together as a named look, then switch whole setups in one click, or on a schedule: at a set time, or at **sunrise** and **sunset** where you are (e.g. a light theme at sunrise, Liquid Glass at sunset). Changing things yourself sticks until the next switch. |
| **Windows colours** | **Use my Windows accent colour** recolours the current theme's highlights to your Windows accent and follows it when you change it; **Follow Windows light/dark** switches with the system. |
| **Liquid glass** | Style → Material turns the sidebar, composer, cards, dialogs, message bubbles and menus into frosted, see-through panes: backdrop blur, a faint frost, a specular top edge and a diagonal sheen. DSH's own surfaces are found at runtime, so it keeps working across DSH updates. **Match my desktop** applies the whole look in one click. |
| **Layout** | Chat width (narrow to full), interface size (75–140 %), and **focus mode**, which folds the sidebar and side panel away. |
| **Wallpaper** | Upload an image or use a URL; (on Windows) **use your desktop wallpaper**, which follows wallpaper changes; **Bing daily**, a new picture every day; a **slideshow** from a folder of images, changing every few minutes to once a day; or a muted, looping **video** that pauses when the window is hidden. Adjustable visibility and blur. |
| **Style** | Interface and code fonts (presets, any installed font, or a folder of `.otf/.ttf/.woff2` files), corner style, accent-tinted chat bubbles, accent text selection, surface tint. |
| **Ambience** | Aurora glow, vignette, film grain or CRT scanlines, with a strength slider. Never blocks clicks; honours reduced motion. |
| **Identity** | Rename the app in the sidebar, swap the logo (emoji, monogram or your own image, removable with one click), and replace the new-chat headline with a greeting like `Good {timeOfDay}, {name}`, in your language. |
| **AI preferences** | Optional custom instructions: your name, about you, a response style (Concise, Thorough, Friendly, Mentor, Butler, Hype), reply language and free-form instructions. **Off by default**; the tab shows exactly what the model will receive. |
| **AI modes** | Saved sets of style, language and instructions: Coding, Writing, Explain simply and Brainstorm to start, plus any you save yourself. Switch with **/ai** in the composer, from Ctrl+K, or on the AI tab. |
| **Saved prompts** | Six starters; add, edit, reorder and file your own into folders. Placeholders fill themselves in when you insert: `{clipboard}`, `{date}`, `{time}`, `{day}`, and `{ask:Topic}`, which asks you first. Share all your prompts as one `dshp1:` pack code, add a pack from a code or file, or send a folder to the gallery. |
| *

plugins.description: 在配置前验证 API Key 和模型可用性，保姆级中文报错诊断插件，专为 DeepSeek Harness 打造。
plugins.readme_text:
# API 体检（DeepSeek Harness 插件） 拿到一个陌生的 API 地址和 Key，不知道它到底能不能用、快不快？ 装上这个插件，在 Harness 左侧栏点一下 **「API 体检」**，填两项，点一下按钮，30 秒给你答案。 ![图标](icon.svg)
English summary Paste an API base URL and an API key, get a verdict in about 30 seconds: does it work, is it fast, how fast, how reliable. - **Time to first token**, **output speed (tok/s)** and **success rate** across N runs. - **Four-layer diagnosis** — network (DNS / TCP / TLS / certificate expiry) → key and model → real streaming conversation → repeated timing runs. - **Evidence-based failure attribution.** Every failure states which step it stalled at and how many bytes actually left your machine, so "nothing happened" stops meaning "the vendor is down". - **37 provider presets** (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-native and Gemini-native), plus a custom entry for anything else. - Model IDs are **never hardcoded** — the plugin asks the endpoint's own `/models` and offers what that server actually serves. - Runs entirely on your machine. Your key is never written to disk or sent anywhere except the endpoint you are testing. Three test suites, 230 checks, CI on Node 20 and 24 across Linux and Windows. MIT licensed. Runs inside DeepSeek Harness (≥ 0.2.0-rc.2) as a plugin.
--- ## 界面 **填好地址和 Key，点一下开始检测。** ![面板](assets/panel-form.png) **测完三个指标一目了然，失败时直接告诉你请求发出去没有。** > 卡在第四步：115 字节的请求正文已经发出去了，服务商连 HTTP 状态行都没回。 ![检测结果](assets/report-result.png) **Key 有效但被限流时，它会直说是限流，不会含糊成「调不动模型」。** ![失败诊断](assets/report-failure.png) **三轮全被掐时，指标显示「—」而不是编一个数，失败原文也一并列出。** ![全失败](assets/report-metrics.png) > 上面几张是在**免费额度**的服务商上测的，成功率没跑满——真实情况就是这样。 > 指标不会为了好看去修饰，缺数据就写「—」。 --- ## 它给你什么 一句话结论，比如： > **能用，而且很快** — 首字 0.42 秒，出字 68 字/秒，连测 5 次全成。 再加上三个数字： | 数字 | 说的是什么 | 怎么看 | |---|---|---| | **首字延迟** | 你按下回车到第一个字出现要多久 | 越低越好。<0.5 秒几乎不用等，超过 2 秒会明显不耐烦 | | **输出速度** | 模型每秒吐多少字 | 越高越顺。<8 就是一个字一个字蹦，>45 基本像看现成文字 | | **成功率** | 连着测这么多次，成了几次 | 低于 80% 建议别上生产 | **三个要一起看。** 首字很快但成功率只有 6 成，说明线路在抖——这种比稳定地慢两秒更难受。 ## 它查四层，出错时告诉你是哪一层坏了 1. **网络** — 域名解析、端口连通、TLS 握手、证书还剩几天 2. **Key 和模型** — Key 有没有效；没指定模型时自动从对方列表里挑一个能对话的 3. **能不能真的说话** — 走完整流式，把模型输出的字直接显示给你 4. **快不快稳不稳** — 连续测 N 次，出首字延迟、速度、成功率 出错时不会丢一句 `HTTP 401` 就完事，而是直接翻译成人话： | 你填错了 | 面板会告诉你 | |---|---| | Key 过期或打错 | Key 无效或没权限 | | Key 有效但欠费 | 命中限流或额度用尽 | | 地址路径不对 | 如实报出**实际请求的是哪个路径**，你自己和文档对一下 | | 域名不存在 | 域名解析不了，检查拼写或 DNS | | 被内容风控拦了 | 请求成功但正文是空的，可能是账号被风控 | ### 它会明确告诉你：请求到底发出去了没有 「没反应」有两种完全相反的情况，混在一起就会变成瞎猜。所以每一次失败都会标出**卡在第几步**，并且报出**实际写出去多少字节**： | 卡在 | 发生了什么 | 接下来怎么办 | |---|---|---| | 第一步 · 连接 | TCP 都没建起来，**一个字节都没发出去** | 查网络、防火墙、域名端口 | | 第二步 · TLS | TCP 通了但加密握手失败，请求没送出 | 看证书，或勾「忽略证书错误」试试 | | 第三步 · 写入 | 连接活着，但请求写不进去 | 换网络（手机热点）或填代理 | | 第四步 · 等回话 | **请求正文已经写出去了**，对方连 HTTP 状态行都没回 | 填代理、调大超时，或等上游 | | 对端断连 | **请求写出去了**，对端一个字节都没给就关连接 | 被网关拦了、Key 被封、或线路不对 | | 等不到正文 | 状态 200，但一个 token 都没等到 | 上游排队或卡死，隔几十秒重试 | 这张表不是装饰。以前只要出现「没回应」，面板一律显示成「调不动模型」——那是在替服务商下结论，而工具当时真正知道的只有「我自己这次请求卡住了」。现在结论会跟着证据走。 --- ## 安装 ### Windows（图形化，不需要敲命令） 1. 双击 **`安装.bat`**（或先双击 `自检.bat` 跑一遍自检） 2. 等它显示「Installed」 3. **把 DeepSeek Harness 完全关掉，再重新打开** 4. 左侧栏多出一个 **「API 体检」**，点进去 卸载：双击 `卸载.bat`，再重启一次 Harness。 > 安装脚本会自动寻找 DeepSeek Harness 的安装位置。如果它装在非常规目录， > 先设一个环境变量再运行： > `set DSH_CLI=D:\你的路径\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd` ### macOS / Linux / 任何地方 `.bat` 只在 Windows 上用得。直接调 CLI 即可： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:"/绝对路径/dsh-api-probe" ``` 装完同样需要**完全重启** DeepSeek Harness —— 插件是启动时加载的，不热更新。 **前置条件**：DeepSeek Harness ≥ `0.2.0-rc.2`。安装前建议先跑一次 `自检.bat` （或 `node tests/run_tests.js` 等三个套件）。 --- ## 怎么用 1. **服务商** — 下拉里选你用的那家，地址会自动填好（37 个预设，覆盖 OpenAI 兼容、 Anthropic 原生、Gemini 原生和本地 Ollama/LM Studio；没有就选「自定义」自己填） 2. **API 地址** — 对方给你的网址。**只填域名也行**，后面自动补 `/v1`；已经带路径的按原样使用 3. **API Key** — 粘贴进来 4. **模型名** — **推荐填上你打算用的那个模型名**，测的就是它。留空则由插件去调 该地址的 `/models` 接口取真实列表，并以可点芯片呈现。填的名字不在列表里会提示 「可能拼错了」并给出最接近的那个，**只警告不中断** 5. 点 **开始检测** 出来的结果可以直接点 **「复制报告」** 发给别人。 > **为什么预设里没有模型名？** 因为同一个模型在不同厂商的 ID 完全不同 > （NVIDIA 的 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash`、Cloudflare 的 > `@cf/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`、深度求索官方的 `deepseek-chat` 是同一个东西）， > 中转站还会再改一次名，而且模型随时下架。过期的提示看起来很权威，却会直接把人 > 送进 400 错误。**该地址自己的 `/models` 响应是唯一不会腐烂的来源。** ### 关于 Key 的安全 - Key 只在这一次请求里用一下，**不写进任何文件** - 面板下方的报告里 Key 是打码的（`sk-a****xyz`） - 地址、模型、超时这些设置会记住，但**永远不记 Key** - Key 的流向只有「你 → 你要测的那个服务商」，没有第三方 ### 需要走网络代理？ 展开 **「高级设置」**，在「代理地址」填 `http://127.0.0.1:7890`（换成你自己用的端口）。留空就是直连。 --- ## 支持哪些接口 | 协议 | 说明 | |---|---| | **OpenAI 兼容** | 几乎所有中转站、国内厂商都走这个，默认就是这个 | | **Anthropic 原生** | DeepSeek / Claude 的 `/messages` 接口 | | **Google Gemini 原生** | Key 放在网址里那种 | **37 个服务商预设**，涵盖阿里云百炼、百川、硅基流动、火山引擎、阶跃星辰、魔搭、 MiniMax、商汤、讯飞星火、月之暗面、智谱，以及 Anthropic、Baseten、Cerebras、 Chutes、Cloudflare Workers AI、DeepInfra、DeepSeek、Featherless、Fireworks、 Gemini、Groq、Hyperbolic、Mistral、Nebius、NVIDIA NIM、Novita、OpenAI、 OpenRouter、Perplexity、SambaNova、Together、xAI，以及本地 Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp·one-api。 完整列表随时可以自己打印： ```bash node tests/check_providers.mjs # 打印全部预设 + 结构校验 node tests/check_providers.mjs --online # 再逐个探测地址是否还活着 # 抽检几家（不必一次全打，避免对网关造成突发流量）： node tests/check_providers.mjs --online --only=xfeng,deepseek,nvidia ``` --- ## 开发者信息 ``` dsh-api-probe/ ├─ lib/index.js 宿主端：探测逻辑 + HTTP 路由 ├─ lib/client.js 前端：React 面板（手写 createElement，无构建步骤） ├─ cordis.patch.yml 让插件出现在 Web 端插件名单里 ├─ tests/ │ ├─ run_tests.js 129 项：探测逻辑、指标口径、各类故障 │ ├─ run_client_tests.mjs 75 项：界面数据契约与文案契约 │ ├─ run_route_tests.js 26 项：HTTP 路由、安全栅栏、NDJSON 流 │ ├─ mock_api.js 测试用假服务端 │ └─ check_providers.mjs 预设地址核对（离线结构 / 在线逐个探测） └─ 安装.bat / 卸载.bat / 自检.bat ``` **跑测试（Node ≥ 20）：** ```bash npm test # 三个套件一起跑 npm run check:providers # 供应商预设结构校验 ``` 无需 `npm install` —— 本插件零第三方依赖。 > ⚠️ **三个套件都要跑。** 改 `PRESETS` 只跑 `run_tests.js` 是抓不到问题的， > 而曾经有一次因为正则没跟着改，19 条断言静默失效、套件照样报绿。 > 详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ### 设计上几个刻意的选择 **用裸 socket 而不是 `fetch`。** 首字延迟要的是每个数据块真实到达的时刻，`fetch` 的封装会把边界抹掉；顺带也躲开了宿主里 undici 全局分发的那个压缩头坑。代理支持 退化成 HTTP CONNECT 隧道。 **路由必须写文档相对路径（`api/...`，不带前导斜杠）。** Harness 用 `` 提供 GUI，写成 `/api/...` 会逃出部署前缀，请求根本到不了插件 （上游 issue #1707）。 **客户端不写 JSX。** 这个文件由浏览器直接执行，没有编译步骤，所以全程 `React.createElement`。 **只用 `react` 和 `react/jsx-runtime` 两个 require。** 这是宿主 `__ModuleLoader__` 唯一提供的东西。 **安全栅栏只有一份。** 探测路由要拿 Key 并向外拨任意 URL，所以必须 loopback-only： socket 地址（`127/8`、`::1`、IPv4-mapped）+ Host 头 + `sec-fetch-site` / `Origin` 同源三重校验；`X-Forwarded-For` 一律不信。配对设备走 `remoteWebUiPairing` 单独放行。 **`state.cfg` 存的是打码副本。** 这个对象会原样回传浏览器并写进报告，明文 Key 不能留在里面——这是实际踩到过的坑。 **预设只存地址，不存模型名。** 厂商控制的字符串会腐烂，而我们自己编的字符串 同样会腐烂，两种都是给用户一个看起来很权威、实际把人送进 400 的答案。模型名 由该地址的 `/models` 决定；地址则用 `check_providers.mjs` 定期复核。 ### 已知边界 - 诊断文案（报错解释、结论）是中文，界面上其余部分是中英双语。诊断文案只有 宿主一份，避免两处维护漂移。 - 没有测 SSE 中途断流后的续传，也不支持流式中途改参数。 - HTTP/2 不支持（走 HTTP/1.1），对测速结果无影响。 - 预设里的 base URL 是**起点，不是保证**：厂商会不打招呼地换域名。 `check_providers.mjs --online` 就是为此存在的。 --- ## 参与贡献 欢迎提 Issue 和 PR。请先读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) —— 里面写清了 「三套件都要跑」和「不要给预设加模型名」这两条踩过坑才定下来的约定。 发现问题请用 [Bug 模板](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml)。 **请不要在 Issue 里贴任何真实的 API Key。** 安全问题请看 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)，走私密上报，不要开公开 Issue。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 LFY-bot

plugins.description: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DeepSeek Harness —— 无需下载 WorkBuddy 桌面端。
plugins.readme_text:
DSH WorkBuddy

Bring WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DeepSeek Harness — no WorkBuddy desktop app required.

English · 中文

- **Sign-in**: per-region browser OAuth, no desktop sign-in at all; a credential from an installed desktop app can still be imported read-only - **Accounts**: region-isolated multi-account list, explicit switching, credit display and warnings; accounts can be given their own names; the plugin's copies are kept apart from the desktop auth files - **One-click check-in**: daily check-in, the cat's growth trip and every growth-center task (签到 / 猫猫旅行) collected in a single action; auto check-in is available and off by default - **Device isolation**: each account's credential, its model catalog and its credit balance stand apart; switching accounts never touches in-flight requests - **Works out of the box**: install it, enable it, and use it from DSH — no extra configuration; DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 desktop is supported today

## Quick start 1. Node 22+, with DSH installed. 2. Install the plugin and start: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy dsh web ``` 3. Open **Settings → Plugins → DSH WorkBuddy**, click **Connect**, and sign in on the WorkBuddy page that opens. 4. Pick a **WorkBuddy** model in the model selector — with the default **free models only** scope, the list is exactly what that region's catalog prices `x0.00` right now. You can also sign in from a terminal: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy login ``` **Restart `dsh web`** after installing, updating, or signing in. Refreshing the browser is not enough — Node modules stay in memory. The default model can be set in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`: ```yaml agent-default-model: provider: workbuddy-ai model: hy3 reasoningEffort: high ``` Use an id the region actually lists: the model list is whatever that region's live catalog returns, so a pinned default can become stale. `hy3` is free in both regions at the time of writing. ## How sign-in works Each region uses the official CLI auth endpoints independently: 1. `POST /v2/plugin/auth/state?platform=CLI&nonce=` (international `www.workbuddy.ai`, domestic `copilot.tencent.com`) 2. Open the returned `authUrl` 3. Poll `GET /v2/plugin/auth/token?state=` (upstream returns `11217` while still pending) 4. The token is written to the region's plugin copy: international `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-ai-auth.json`, domestic `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-cn-auth.json` The desktop app's `workbuddy-desktop-ai.info` (international) and `workbuddy-desktop.info` (domestic) are read-only — the plugin never writes them. It only stores its own per-region credential copies obtained through OAuth. The settings card lists every imported account. Switching only affects subsequent requests; in-flight requests keep using the original account, and bulk credit/check-in operations do not change the current selection. **Disconnect** / `logout` only deletes that region's own plugin credentials; the desktop app is untouched. ## Configuration Settings → Plugins → **DSH WorkBuddy**: - **Connect / Disconnect**: per-region browser sign-in, or delete that region's plugin credentials - Domestic/international account lists, explicit switching, remaining credits, and a connectivity test - Tick domestic accounts, auto check-in (off by default) - The active account refreshes read-only every 15 minutes and others every 60 minutes by default — configurable - **Free models only** (default) / **All models** Or configure it in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: llm-workbuddy config: modelScope: free # international: or all cnModelScope: free # domestic: or all probeConsent: false # real model probing off by default autoCheckin: false # domestic auto check-in off by default refreshActiveMinutes: 15 refreshInactiveMinutes: 60 # Hosts used to reach DSH Web over the LAN (do not add these to LOOPBACK) # allowedHosts: ["192.168.1.10"] # authFile / cnAuthFile: rarely needed; only for a non-default desktop credential path ``` Environment variables: | Variable | Effect | |---|---| | `DSH_WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE` | Override the international desktop credential path (OAuth credentials still go to the plugin's own file) | | `DSH_WORKBUDDY_CN_AUTH_FILE` | Override the domestic desktop credential path | ## CLI ```sh dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy login dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy status dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy doctor dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy logout ``` `status` / `doctor` accept `--json`. `logout` only deletes `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-ai-auth.json`. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Fix | |---|---| | No card in settings / no WorkBuddy in the model list | Restart `dsh web`; refreshing the browser is not enough | | `dsh web` exits after clicking Connect | On headless Linux without `xdg-open`, update to a build with spawn `error` handling; use the sign-in link on the card | | 403 `request-not-trusted` when opening the card over a LAN IP | Add that IP/hostname to `allowedHosts`; do not put it in the loopback list | | Signed in but no models | The region's catalog request failed or returned nothing — check connectivity and whether the token is still valid; the list stays empty rather than borrowing the other region's models | | `doctor` says signed-out | Run `login` first, or confirm the international desktop app is signed in | | Want paid models | Switch the scope to "All models" on the settings card — credits will be burned | ```sh dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy doctor ``` ## Disclaimer For personal learning and research only, driving your own WorkBuddy account on your own machine. Follow the WorkBuddy terms of service. This project is not affiliated with Tencent, WorkBuddy, or DeepSeek. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: 流明市场：DSH 插件发现、介绍与文档、GitHub 仓库查验，以及官方管线安装和更新。
plugins.readme_text:
# 流明市场 · Lumen Market

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供 npm 与 GitHub 插件发现、兼容性查验和安装管理。

[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lumen-market) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/Femad-6/dsh-lumen-market/issues)

当前版本：**0.5.2**。

## 功能

- 搜索 npm 与 GitHub 插件，查看介绍、源码和文档。
- 发现页只展示未安装插件，每页 21 项，支持来源筛选和 GitHub 排序。
- 安装前查验兼容性，通过 DSH 官方管理器安装、更新和卸载。
- 查看已安装插件与可用更新，显示操作进度和重启提醒；可升级插件显示小灯提示。
- 本地保存发现结果，查询失败或限流时继续显示缓存。

## 安装

在 DSH 的「插件 → 添加插件」中输入：

```text
dsh-lumen-market@0.5.2
```

按官方管理器提示完成安装。需要支持官方插件管理器的 DeepSeek Harness；Node.js 22 或更高版本。

## 使用须知

- npm 来源支持检查版本更新；本地链接和 Git 来源暂不支持按包名升级。
- Star 数目前仅显示在 GitHub 来源的结果中。
- GitHub 查询可能受到限流；已有缓存时会继续展示，并标注缓存时间。
- 截图中的背景和配色来自 DSH 宿主主题，不是插件自带皮肤。

[更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

## 界面预览

**发现插件**

![搜索 npm 与 GitHub 插件](docs/screenshots/discover-search.png)

**已安装插件与升级提示灯**

![已安装插件及升级预览旁的小灯](docs/screenshots/installed-update-light.png)

**查看可用更新**

![可更新插件列表](docs/screenshots/updates-light.png)

**GitHub 星标排序**

![按 GitHub 星标排列搜索结果](docs/screenshots/github-stars.png)

截图由实际使用界面提供，版本和查询状态以拍摄时为准。

## 许可证

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-stt Multi-model local speech recognition for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web composer. A microphone appears between the model selector and Send. **Click once and start talking** — the recording ends on its own about a second after you stop speaking, and the transcript is inserted into the draft for review. **You choose which on-device model transcribes**, and nothing is downloaded until you choose it. The recognizer is loaded when you *start* recording, not when you finish, so the wait happens behind your own voice instead of after it. ## Models | Pick | Size | Languages | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | **Whistle** (Cactus Compute) | **18.4 MB** | 7, auto-detected | default; loads in 30 ms, ~116 MB RAM | | **Voz** (Desert Ant Labs) | ~390 MB | 25 | higher accuracy; ~1 GB RAM while warm | | SenseVoice | — | — | *coming soon* — advertised only, downloads nothing | Both working models were measured end-to-end on Windows and each transcribed a 7.62 s clip correctly: Whistle in 1.52 s using 116 MB, Voz in 2.39 s. ## Install This is a **rider** on the shipped voice bundle: that bundle supplies the microphone UI and the speech service, and this package adds the models. Install both, **in this order** — layers apply in list order and a later layer wins for a given row id: ```sh # The voice-bundle version MATTERS: plain `add` resolves the npm `latest` tag # (0.1.7-alpha.1), which does not match a DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 runtime. Pin yours. dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add @try-works/dsh-stt ``` Installing from a checkout instead of the registry works the same way: `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-stt`. Then open **Settings → Plugins → Voice Input** and pick a model. The picker lists every model with its size and time estimate; **Download and prepare** fetches only the one you selected. ## Configuration `cordis.patch.yml` carries the whole configuration. Each model is a key under `providers`: ```yaml providers: whistle-local: enabled: true voz-local: enabled: false # keep 390 MB out of the picker entirely sensevoice-local: enabled: true # placeholder only ``` | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `enabled` | `false` stops the provider registering — it is never listed, selected or downloaded | | `modelRoot` | where that model's files live; defaults to `/` | | `id` | override the provider id (advanced; the selection is stored by id) | | `name` | override the display name shown in the picker | `dataRoot` is required and must be an absolute path. ## How the recording ends A silence gate watches the microphone level. Nothing stops until it has heard **300 ms of speech**, so a cough or a door cannot end a recording before you have said anything; after that, **1.2 s of quiet** ends it. The Stop button is still there, and Escape or switching away cancels and discards. Because this needs the microphone level, the plugin ships its own browser half and registers it into the composer slot at a lower priority than the shipped microphone, which therefore stops rendering. That is also why the wait disappears: the same half asks the host to load the model the moment recording starts. ## Architecture ``` src/index.js register every enabled provider src/config.js schemastery configuration src/provider-kit/ http.js resumable download (see below) preparation.js disk inspection + the state the UI renders oneshot.js one process per recording worker.js one warm process, idle-reclaimed src/providers/whistle/ one-shot: needle.exe per recording src/providers/voz/ warm worker holding the model src/providers/sensevoice/ placeholder: advertises, never downloads ``` ### Two deliberate engine strategies Whistle runs **one process per recording**. Its engine loads the 16.9 MB model in ~30 ms, so paying that per request buys real crash isolation and automatic memory reclamation. It also satisfies the engine's *one process-global model per kind* rule for free. Voz runs as a **warm worker** because its load costs 6.2 s and about a gigabyte; the child persists between recordings and is released after five idle minutes. ### Why we download the models ourselves `Voz.load()` fetches its 384,832,967 bytes with a single `fetch` per file and **no retry, no resume and no timeout**. On a real connection that failed at 37.5% of the largest file, and a resumable retry hit three more drops. Preparation therefore pre-populates Voz's cache with a resumable `Range` download, after which `Voz.load({ cache: true })` adopts the files without fetching. ## Limitations - **Insert, not send.** The transcript lands in the draft; you press Enter. No message is ever sent on your behalf. - **The microphone UI is the shipped one.** This package contributes providers only, because the picker is keyed to the shipped voice bundle's detail page. - **SenseVoice is advertised, not delivered.** Its entry cannot be downloaded; see the hand-over note in `src/providers/sensevoice/index.js`. - **Recording limits** are the seam's defaults: 4 MB and 120 s per recording. Whistle's engine accepts only 30 s per call, so a longer recording is cut at the quietest nearby moment and transcribed in segments that are joined in order. Nothing to configure; 45 s of speech costs roughly 12 s of inference. - Local means *the Host machine*, which may be remote from your browser.

plugins.description: DSH ZCode UI — 把 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面换成 ZCode 风格：侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。A ZCode-styled sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation skin for DSH Web.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ZCode UI **A ZCode-style visual skin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web — sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, turn navigation** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) [![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH Web Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Web-Plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui) [![Node.js 22 or later](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22%20or%20later-339933.svg?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org/)
> [!IMPORTANT] > **This is a personal, community-maintained project. It carries no official endorsement.** > It is **not** a DeepSeek AI product, and it is **not** an official plugin of any kind — it is maintained by one individual (`jungenius-stack`) in their own time. > It is a fork of the open-source project [MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) (Apache-2.0), and its design values are taken from [zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode) (Apache-2.0). > "DeepSeek", "DeepSeek Harness" and "ZCode" are the property of their respective owners; the names are used here only to describe compatibility and design provenance. > [!WARNING] > **Beta — this is an early test build.** The interface and behaviour still change quickly, and the rough edges are listed openly in [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md). > **Corrections and improvement suggestions are genuinely welcome** — please open an [issue](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui/issues). The most useful report is short: what you expected, what happened, and a screenshot if the problem is visual. DSH ZCode UI repaints the DSH Web interface in ZCode's (Zhipu / Zai) visual language: the sidebar, the workspace session tree, the header search, and the composer all adopt ZCode geometry, palette, and iconography — in both light and dark themes. **The skin itself changes nothing else.** Everything it draws flows through DSH's own `SlotRegistry` slots and `ctx` public services, and it never writes conversation records. One thing worth stating plainly, because the paragraph above used to overstate it: this package is a fork of [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) and **also carries upstream's non-visual features** — a dependency panel that can run `pnpm` and rewrite `node_modules`, session moves between workspaces, and "open in file manager". They are inherited rather than written here, and they are what the About page exposes. You can simply not use them, but they do ship in this package. See [Scope and permissions](#scope-and-permissions). ## What you get | Area | What the skin does | | --- | --- | | **Layout** | ZCode sidebar geometry — 8px radii, 32px rows, `px-2 / py-3 / gap-1` spacing, 150–200ms `ease-out` motion, seven-step type scale | | **Colour** | Full Zai Light / Zai Dark palettes written into DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer; official regions (title bar, session list, buttons, menus, composer shell) recolour as one piece | | **Icons** | Lucide (the same icon library ZCode uses) for sidebar navigation and row actions | | **Theme** | Follows the host's own light/dark preference via `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; light canvas `#f8f8f8`, dark canvas `#161616` | | **Sidebar behaviour** | Pin / group / drag-reorder projects and conversations, unread and running indicators, header search over sessions + settings + quick actions, rename / archive / fork / copy / delete, turn navigation in long conversations, Up/Down recall of previous input | ## Screenshots The two images at the top of this page are the light and dark sidebar + workspace tree. A few more views. > Project names, conversation titles and the balance figures in every screenshot are **demo data** — the > captures are sanitised before committing so no real workspace ever appears in this repository. > > **Re-captured for 1.15.0** (2026-10-18) against a live host (`0.2.1-rc.2`) in an isolated profile, > so the session indent, monochrome card icons and wider group spacing shown here are the real thing. > Demo data only — no real workspace appears in this repository. Settings page — selected states are neutral, matching the sidebar (no blue leftovers from the host defaults): ![Settings page, light theme](assets/screenshots/settings-light.png) Header search across conversations and settings: ![Header search, light theme](assets/screenshots/search-light.png) Collapsed rail — icon-only, with tooltips on hover: ![Collapsed rail, light theme](assets/screenshots/collapsed-light.png) ## How it differs from upstream This fork keeps upstream's interaction scaffolding and data layer, and adds: - **The ZCode skin itself** — 174 `--dsw-*` tokens per theme (light and dark) plus 23 structural tokens, 197 unique token names in total. Every token consumed anywhere in `src/` is covered by the maps; the `token-coverage` assertion fails the build if that ever stops being true. - **Theme single-source-of-truth** — the host attribute is the only signal. No `prefers-color-scheme` fallback, which used to split the sidebar and the content area when the host was light but the OS was dark. - **Fixes found by looking at the real interface**, not by reading code: session hover card trimmed to the title only, send button rendered in the real primary colour (`--dcu-primary` is now defined at `:root` so the composer — which lives outside `.dcu-root` — can resolve it), a "back to conversation" entry when a global panel is open, self-drawn sidebar separator lines removed, marquee title clipping, footer separation, and shorter empty-state cards. - **A verification stack that actually runs on this machine** — see [Verification](#verification). Upstream's browser-based layout scripts had never been executed here before (the Chromium binary was missing), which is how five stale assertions stayed hidden. ## Scope and permissions A skin should not need a permissions conversation. This one does, because it is a fork and inherited more than visuals. Being explicit is cheaper than being trusted by accident. | Capability | Reachable from | Touches | | --- | --- | --- | | Recolour the UI | always, on install | DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer and this plugin's own stylesheets. No data. | | Sidebar / session tree / search | always, on install | Renders through official slots. Reads session and workspace lists; never writes conversation records. | | Dependency panel | the About page, on click | Runs `pnpm`, rewrites `node_modules` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` in the active workspace. | | Move session to workspace | the session context menu | Rewrites that session's artifact files. | | Open in file manager | file path menus | Opens the OS file manager. Read-only. | | Five REST endpoints | the plugin's own UI only | Serves the four features above; authenticated per session. | Everything in the lower four rows is **inherited from [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)** and is also exposed on the About page inside DSH. If you only want the skin, nothing here runs unless you click it. ## Requirements - A working **DeepSeek Harness Web** installation with `dsh` on your `PATH`. Examples below use the `web` profile; substitute your own profile name. - **Host compatibility.** Peer dependencies declare the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` range `>=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0`; development is pinned to `0.2.0-rc.2`. The heavy gate (`pnpm gate:host`) packs the plugin, installs it into an isolated `DSH_HOME`, and exercises the real `dsh` binary found on the machine — override it with `DCU_DSH_BIN`. - **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** if you build from source. - ⚠️ On macOS, do **not** put DSH's bundled Node 24 first on `PATH` when building or testing: it cannot load the `rolldown` native binding (`code signature ... different Team IDs`) and `vitest` / `tsdown` will fail.

plugins.description: DSH注入系统提示词和设置注入上下文插件。内置吃白饭的蓝色大肥鱼拟人鲸鱼娘女仆角色扮演设定！
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-persona-select · 人设管理与人设注入 > DSH 插件：把人设正文注入**系统提示词**，把历史对话注入**上下文**。设置页的人设管理负责保存与编辑，对话模式选择行下方可以随时切换人设。 > > Bilingual README. [中文](#中文) · [English](#english) --- --- ## 中文 ### 这个插件做什么 它负责两件事：把一段文字送进**系统提示词**，把一段对话送进**上下文**。为了说清楚，本文与插件设置界面统一使用两个叫法： | 叫法 | 指的是 | | --- | --- | | **人设正文** | 注入系统提示词的那段内容 | | **历史对话** | 作为上下文注入的一段"已经发生过"的对话 | 两者按**人设**成对保存：在设置页把人设正文和历史对话写好、存成一条预设「人设」，之后在对话里选中这条人设，两者按各自的规则进入这一次请求。 ### 注入的规则 **人设正文**进入系统提示词的**人设段**，**注入位置可自行编辑**：「段序权重」决定这一段排在系统提示词的哪个位置。 - **数值**：按权重大小排序，**数字越小越靠前**（默认 `-1`，排在预设里那句 "You are a coding agent…" 之前）。 - **追随**：点「追随」后，人设段被放到**所有系统提示词段之后**。 - 权重只影响排序，**永远不会混进人设正文**；每条人设各自保存自己的权重，编辑框跟着当前选中的那条人设走。 - 必须填整数（`-1000000000` ~ `1000000000`）：小数、指数、带单位都会被拒绝保存。 **历史对话**在**新对话的第一步**作为 user 侧上下文注入一次，并按仿照 DSH 自身注入的格式包裹： - 整段包进一对 ``，开口之后是 `CONTEXT_ROAD:`，结尾是 `CONTINUE_CONTEXT.`；正文里出现的收尾标签会被转义，保证壳子不会被提前闭合。 - 往期对话的 user 侧内容包在 `` 里；模型侧的思考包在 `` 里、说的话包在 `` 里；双方非对话内容包在 `` 之类的标记里；压缩摘要保持 `…` 原样。 **已经注入过的对话不会重复注入**（那会把整段对话的缓存读取推倒重来）。所以历史对话只在每个新对话的第一步生效；如果想让一个已经聊起来的对话也带上历史，只能把历史写进人设正文——但效果不好，不推荐。 ### 人设管理 - 新建、编辑、保存、删除人设，**复制为新人设**（内置人设只读，要改就复制一份副本再改）。 - 每一条人设包含：名称、人设正文、段序权重、历史对话。 - **设置分开保存**：每个对话保存自己的选择与开关，**切换人设、改动勾选项都不会影响新对话和进行中的对话**。设置页有「当前 / 全局」两个页签，分别对应"这一个对话"和"新对话默认跟随的设置"。 - 保存前会先校验：正文为空、名称为空、权重不是整数都会拒绝保存并说明原因；正文超过建议上限会提示但完整保留。 - 未保存的改动在切换人设时会先询问，避免默默丢掉。 ### 屏蔽与「纯聊天」 四个开关各自撤掉一类模型本来能看到的**系统侧输入**： | 开关 | 撤掉什么 | | --- | --- | | **只留人设** | 系统提示词里除人设段以外的所有段：harness 身份、部署人设、工具指引、计划模式策略、harness 源码说明。人设为空时，系统提示词就是空的。 | | **屏蔽 runtime 上下文** | 两类：① 沙箱策略、审批策略、委派规则等以 user 角色快照下发的动态上下文；② 包在 `` 里的 runtime 快照与 skill 目录。 | | **屏蔽 schema 工具** | 工具定义（它走独立的协议字段，不是系统提示词段，通常是最大的一笔 token）。打开后模型没有可调用的工具。 | | **屏蔽其他注入内容** | AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 之类的指令基线与逐步时间读数——它们同样是以 user 角色消息追加进来的，只能按来源过滤。 | 四个开关全开、且没有选中人设，就是**纯聊天**：系统侧注入归零，模型只看到你发的内容。对话界面的选择框里有「一键纯聊天 / 恢复系统输入」按钮直接切换这两个状态。 **工具保活通道**（「可复用工具」）：屏蔽 schema 工具的保险丝。DSH 的工具账本要求每个对话有一份非空的工具声明基线，基线一旦被清空，回来的工具都会被打上 deferred 标记并被服务方以 `INVALID_REQUEST` 拒绝。勾上它，插件只在**两个时刻**保留完整工具列表各一轮——这个对话的**第一次请求**，以及**疑似声明序列重启**（例如压缩）时——先让基线建立起来，之后无论怎么开关屏蔽，工具都还能回来。 以下为关闭所有系统测注入后，你能够真实达到的token消耗 ### 导入与导出 **导出**（设置页编辑器里那条人设的正文 + 段序权重 + 历史对话一起走）： - **导出 JSON**：纯 JSON，不压缩、不丢信息。 - **导出图片**：由**你自己挑一张 PNG 当封面**，同样的数据打进图片里一起作为一张角色卡下载。图片本身的数据一个字节都不改，包括AI生图或捏人游戏角色卡(导出为png格式的游戏，例如恋活)，任何看图软件照常显示它。 - 单次导出上限 32 MB；选了非 PNG、或 PNG 结构不完整（读不出 IHDR）会被直接拒绝并说明原因。 - 导出取的是编辑器里那条人设**已保存**的版本：有未保存改动会先询问，新建但还没保存的人设不能导出。 **导入**： - 读本插件导出的 `.json`，或「导出图片」生成的那张 `.png`，作为**新人设追加**进列表——**绝不覆盖已有条目**。 - **直接导入 DSH 自己 `/export` 出来的 Session 日志**：接受 `/export` 产生的 `.zip`，也接受裸的 `session.vN.jsonl` / `session.jsonl`，以及 `.jsonl.zstd` / `.zst`。导入时两个独立开关： - **导入思考过程**：决定模型侧的 `` 跟不跟着进来。 - **展开压缩**：默认只取压缩摘要 `` 与**最后一次摘要之后**的对话；勾上后反过来——取**除摘要之外**的全部内容，把压缩展开回原文。历史从未压缩过时，这个勾选项不改变任何东西。 ### 对话界面的选择框 对话模式选择行下方那个「人设」展开： - 切换当前对话的人设，或选「不注入」。 - **一键纯聊天 / 恢复系统输入**。 - 层徽标告诉你这条设置是**本对话**的还是**全局**的。 - 状态点： - 绿点：工具基线可用，一切正常。 - 黄点：本对话选定人设的历史对话与当初注入的那份对不上了；本对话的人设正文没进系统提示词（例如对话用了声明 `complete: true` 的「极简模式」）；本对话已经聊过，所以这条人设的历史对话不再注入；或「可复用工具」没勾。 - 红点：本对话选的人设已被删除（人设段现在是空的），或这个对话的首次请求没带任何工具（工具基线为空，本对话内工具回不来）。 - 设置页的「当前」页会按来源列出**这个对话里被过滤掉**的注入块：runtime 快照、skill 目录、工作区指令、时间读数。 ### 数据文件 `/persona-select/`（`DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`）： | 文件 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `personas.json` | 全局设置、人设列表、每个对话的选择与开关 | | `personas.json.v2-backup` | 旧版升级时的备份，可删 | | `history/<编号>.txt` | 各条人设的历史对话正文 | - 名称最长 40 字；人设正文建议不超过 20000 字（超过会提示，但完整保留、不截断）；最多 200 条人设；最多保留 500 条对话记录。 - 会话记录会被自动清理：已经不存在、也不在活动列表里的对话记录会被回收（设置页也可主动触发），避免文件无限膨胀。 ### 界面 设置页与对话界面均跟随宿主语言，内置中文 / English 两套文案。 ### 内置人设声明 插件中“鲸鱼娘”的形象描述来自[@ZipZipPipe](https://space.bilibili.com/4168597)，遵守CC BY-NC-SA 4.0协议再创作并开源，请尊重相关形象创造者。 --- ## English ### What this plugin does Two jobs: put a block of text into the **system prompt**, and put a stretch of conversation into the **context**. To keep the wording precise, this README uses the same two names as the plugin UI: | Term | Meaning | | --- | --- | | **Persona text** | the content injected into the system prompt | | **Conversation history** | a stretch of "already happened" dialogue injected as context | The two are stored together as one **persona**: write the text and the history in the settings page, save them as a persona preset, then pick that persona in a conversation and both enter the request by their own rules. ### How injection works **Persona text** becomes the **persona section** of the system prompt, and **its position is yours to edit**: the "Section order weight" decides where that section sits. - **A number**: sections sort by weight, **lower comes first** (default `-1`, ahead of the preset line "You are a coding agent…"). - **Follow**: click it and the persona section is appended **after every system-prompt section**. - The weight only affects ordering and **never enters the persona text**. Each persona keeps its own weight, and the field follows whichever persona you are editing. - It must be an integer (`-1000000000` to `1000000000`): decimals, exponents and units are refused on save. **Conversation history** is injected once, as user-side context, at the **first step of a new conversation**, wrapped in a shell that imitates how DSH itself injects context: - the whole block sits inside one `` pair, opened by `CONTEXT_ROAD:` and closed by `CONTINUE_CONTEXT.`; any closing tag occurring in the body is escaped so the shell can never be closed early. - inside it, past user-side content goes inside ``; the model side's thinking goes inside ``, its spoken content inside ``; non-conversational content from either side (tool calls, multimodal parts) goes inside markers such as ``; compaction summaries stay wrapped in `…`, verbatim. **A conversation that has already been injected is never injected again** — doing so would tear down the whole conversation's cached input(KV cache). History therefore only takes effect on the first step of each new conversation. If an already-running conversation must carry history across a persona switch, you can write that history into the persona text itself — the result is poor, so it is not recommended. ### Managing personas - Create, edit, save and delete personas, and **fork as new** (built-in personas are read-only; fork a copy to edit one). - Each persona carries: name, persona text, section order weight, conversation history. - **Settings are saved per conversation**: each conversation keeps its own selection and switches, so **switching personas or toggling a switch never affects new conversations or conversations in progress**. The settings page has a Current / Global tab pair — "this conversation" versus "what new conversations follow". - Saving validates first: empty text, empty name or a non-integer weight is refused with a reason; text over the recommended limit is reported but kept in full. - Unsaved edits trigger a confirmation before switching personas, so nothing is silently dropped. ### Suppression and pure chat Four switches, each removing one class of system-side input the model would otherwise see: | Switch | What it removes | | --- | --- | | **Persona only** | Every system-prompt section except the persona: harness identity, deployment persona, tool guidance, plan-mode policy, harness-source notes.
